description: Retrieval evaluation set. 'expected_contains' is a phrase that must appear in one of the top-k retrieved chunks. 'paraphrased' questions deliberately avoid the documents' wording. 'out_of_scope' questions must NOT be answerable.

How many unused leave days can I carry forward to next year?

in_scope.question: What happens if I get a performance rating below 2?
